kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Happy Wok in Innsbruck**

Discover authentic Asian flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! At **Happy Wok**, we bring you a taste of the East with our delicious and fresh dishes. Whether you're craving sizzling wok stir-fries, fragrant curries, or crispy spring rolls, our menu has something for everyone.

**Why visit us?**
✔ **Fresh ingredients** – Only the best for your plate!
✔ **Quick & tasty** – Enjoy your meal in a cozy atmosphere.
✔ **Takeaway & delivery** – Because good food should never wait.

**Must-try dishes:**
🍜 **Peking Duck** – Crispy, tender, and served with thin pancakes.
🍛 **Sweet & Sour Chicken** – A classic with a tangy twist.
🍢 **Szechuan Beef** – Spicy, aromatic, and full of flavor.
🍢 **Vegetable Stir-Fry** – Light, healthy, and packed with veggies.
